projectDescription: A dark-retro, occult-themed personal portfolio and developer showcase built with React, Framer Motion, and Tailwind CSS, featuring animated components, a skill constellation, and an immersive visual experience.
keyFeatures: Dark occult-themed aesthetic with neon glow effects (electric-purple, neon-lime, magenta, cyan)
Custom cursor component replacing the default browser cursor
Animated background atmosphere with ambient particle effects
Summoning Circle SVG animation on the home page
Typewriter-effect hero text with animated letter reveal
Interactive skill constellation graph with hover tooltips and connection lines
Drag-and-drop Cauldron ingredient interaction on the Skills page
Cards of Fate — interactive tarot-style project highlight cards
Timeline milestones for the About/Origin Story page
Three distinct project tile styles (hexagon, terminal, runestone) on the Projects page
Filterable writing/blog articles with torn and folded card formats
Animated contact form with glowing inputs and a guestbook
Framer Motion page transitions with blur and slide animations
CRT scanline overlay effect on code blocks
Custom scrollbar styled with electric-purple accent
Cinzel Decorative serif font for headings and JetBrains Mono for code/body
publicApiSurface: CustomCursor — custom SVG cursor with AnimatePresence mode
HeroText — animated typewriter headline (name: 'Alex Morgan', tagline: 'Source Code, Summoned.')
SummoningCircle — SVG summoning circle animation component
ProjectMarquee — horizontal scrolling project name ticker
SkillConstellation — interactive SVG node graph of tech skills
TimelineMilestones — vertical timeline with alternating left/right milestone cards (2018–Present)
ThingsINotice — reflective 'things I notice' personality section
ProjectTiles — three layout variants: HexagonTile, TerminalTile, RunestoneTile
ArticleFormats — two article card styles: TornCard, FoldedCard
useScreenInit — React screen initialization hook (wraps React namespace for components)
Layout (AppShell) — fixed header with 'DC' logo, route-based nav links, AnimatePresence page transitions
